idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes Files
idea-plugin.description: Browse Kubernetes container files inside IntelliJ IDEA. Upload local files by drag and drop, download remote files, and track cancellable binary transfers with SHA-256 verification. With Kubernetes enabled, right-click a Pod or container in Services and choose 浏览容器文件…, or use the matching folder toolbar button to open Files beside the native Information / Shell tabs. Multi-container Pods expose a container submenu; each container has its own reusable Files tab. Cancellable transfers report file progress and speed through the IDE background task indicator. Configure the default remote directory under Settings / Tools / Kubernetes Files, or leave it empty to detect the container working directory. Also available from Tools or Control+Option+Shift+K (⌃⌥⇧K) on macOS / Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K on Windows/Linux. Requires kubectl and a POSIX shell in the container. Targeted at IDEA Ultimate 2026.2.
